summary: Frontend-only validation of 4 new features on EZtoFind.ca. All tests passed: (1) /living-in/maple-ridge renders H1, all 5 section data-testids (overview, getting_around, amenities, climate, housing), living-in-faq, and living-in-cta with 'See Maple Ridge homes for sale' and 'I'm buying in Maple Ridge' CTAs. (2) /living-in/kelowna (out-of-region) renders H1 but shows living-in-unavailable note and no section content. (3) Admin /admin/approvals shows approvals-tab-guides ('📍 Living-In Guides (0)'); clicking it reveals generate-all-guides button and empty-state message ('No pending neighbourhood guides...'). (4) Admin /admin/consent exposes all required testids (consent-search-input, consent-date-from, consent-date-to, consent-unsub-only, consent-search-btn); empty-search triggers consent-err; date-range search returned 78 records in consent-results + admin-consent-table; Clear button appeared; Unsubscribed-only alone returned 0 records without error (consent-results rendered). Homepage hn-listing-hero renders without errors (no Featured tag — expected per task note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 features working end-to-end via UI. Maple-ridge guide approved and public. Kelowna correctly out-of-region. Admin guides tab shows empty state (0 pending). Consent filters: date-range, unsub-only, and empty-validation all work. Homepage hero renders (no active featured listing).
